name: Chorus-Ensemble modes: Classic, Ensemble, Vibrato
goal: Thicken cinematic pads with a multi-mode chorus: Classic (2 delayed copies + LFO on delay time), Ensemble (third evenly-split copy for fuller body), or Vibrato (pitch-only wobble); tune rate/amount/feedback/width/dry-wet, high-pass the wet to avoid mud, optional warmth/saturation, and LFO offset for stereo vibrato.
prerequisites: Stereo chorus/ensemble FX with Classic/Ensemble/Vibrato-style modes (or portable multi-voice chorus + vibrato); pad/synth source

inputs.name: rate_amount
inputs.description: LFO rate + depth sweet spot for warm thickness vs obvious wobble

outputs.name: chorus_ensemble_rack
outputs.description: Configured multi-mode chorus/ensemble/vibrato on pad bus

steps.action: Choose mode: Classic duplicates the input twice with short delay; LFO modulates those delay times (also slight pitch) so stacked copies thicken/widen. Ensemble adds a third evenly-split copy for a richer full-bodied chorus. Vibrato modulates pitch only (feedback and dry/wet disabled in that mode).
steps.expect: Mode matches desired thickness vs pitch wobble

steps.action: In Classic/Ensemble: set rate and amount to a warm sweet spot; raise both together only when you want obvious oscillations. Use feedback to stack more copies—extreme feedback turns metallic; Invert Polarity makes feedback hollow.
steps.expect: Warm thickness without harsh metallic swirl unless intended

steps.action: Enable high-pass on the processed path and raise cutoff so lows are cut—prevents mud/clipping when feedback/rate are high.
steps.expect: Chorus motion without low-end mud or clipping

steps.action: Set width: 0% = mono chorus; up to extreme (~200% when available) spreads copies L/R. Blend with dry/wet so the pad stays present.
steps.expect: Desired spatial spread with audible dry body

steps.action: Optional warmth/saturation at end of the device for subtle drive. In Vibrato: use small amount + faster rate to humanize leads/pads; Offset splits LFO L vs R (up to 180°) for spatial vibrato; Shape sine→triangle for sharper edges.
steps.expect: Subtle warmth and/or controlled vibrato motion

verification: Classic or Ensemble thickens without wrecking low end (HPF engaged if feedback high)
Width and dry/wet leave mono-compatible body when width is reduced
Vibrato (if used) only pitch-modulates; feedback/dry-wet not required
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Ableton/Vital/Serum/VAST/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
Not affiliated with plugin/synth vendors named in the source video.
Place chorus early in Traveler-style FX order (after EQ, before delay/reverb) when building a cinematic pad bus.
